summary: First-build end-to-end verification for TechSathi AI. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass against the public URL covering health, tools list, Claude-powered /api/ai/generate (EN + Hinglish), invalid-tool 400, /api/chat, and /api/waitlist create+idempotency+count. Frontend: Playwright E2E confirms homepage load, EN↔Hinglish language toggle changes hero copy, hero CTA scrolls to Playground, tool-select + Use-example + Generate produces a real ~4.2KB Claude output in the playground-output region, 3 pricing cards, 6 FAQ items (expand works), and waitlist submission shows the success state ("You're in! We'll reach out soon"). No console or on-page errors detected.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: @app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI — migrate to lifespan context manager (non-blocking, future-proofing).

server.py: /api/waitlist/count adds a hard-coded +1247 bootstrap offset. Acceptable for launch social-proof, but should be moved to env var (e.g. WAITLIST_BOOTSTRAP) so it can be tuned without code changes.
server.py: run_claude surfaces raw error text (sliced to 200 chars) in 500 responses — fine for MVP but consider logging-only in production to avoid leaking upstream details.
server.py: No rate limiting on /api/ai/generate or /api/chat — public endpoints hitting a paid LLM key; add a simple IP-based throttle before public launch.
Good practices observed: pydantic validation, Mongo _id excluded via projection, uuid ids, env-driven config, CORS configured, proper async usage throughout.
test_credentials: N/A — app has no auth (per PRD). /app/memory/test_credentials.md not required.
seed_data_creation: Only transient TEST_<uuid>@example.com waitlist entries created during tests; app is not admin-gated so cleanup is not critical.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). They require EMERGENT_LLM_KEY to be set in /app/backend/.env (already configured). Claude generate calls take ~5-15s each; TIMEOUT set to 90s. The frontend has data-testid on: language-toggle, nav-cta-button, hero-primary-cta, hero-mascot, playground-tool-select, playground-prompt-input, playground-use-example, playground-generate-btn, playground-output, pricing-card-*, faq-item-*, waitlist-form, waitlist-email-input, waitlist-submit — use these for future UI tests.
